blurb: Messorem is a microbrewery that uses the best ingredients to create beers they personally want to drink, specializing in hoppy and sour-style beers. They have a tasting room on site and a barrel-aging program with French oak and bourbon barrels. Their beers are available on tap and for purchase to go at their location.
extraNote: No growler fills currently · No distribution currently · Follow social media for release updates · Messorem Bracitorium, 2233 Pitt Street, Montreal
